posts.caption:

Stay tuned for the recap video & the announcement for the “Fall Games” 💙

posts.alt: A month ago we celebrated our 3rd year hosting our signature fundraiser, Yachts & Things!
posts.caption:
A month ago we celebrated our 3rd year hosting our signature fundraiser, Yachts & Things! 🛥️🥂 To the amazing team and all parties involved in making it such a great event & weekend, thank you! And to each and every attendee, thanks for making year 3 special. 

We want your thoughts on the event! PLEASE fill out the survey link in our bio (even if you didn’t attend)! Follow us to stay updated before the next one. 👀

Next up is our Summer Things Series! Stay on the lookout for updates *very* soon! 💙

📸: @hesxparadise x @stevietofficial1
